purpose: Exact symbolic cross-check of the displayed simplex map and the three multiplicative factors used in the source proof for strict product descent.
constraints_used_in_interpretation: x,y,z > 0 and x+y+z=1; this file computes algebraic identities only.
mathematical_readout: On the simplex, each factor is positive: 1+y-z=x+2y, 1+z-x=y+2z, 1+x-y=z+2x. Their sum is 3, so AM-GM gives product <= 1 with equality only when all three factors are 1, which forces x=y=z=1/3. Thus for an interior point other than M0, phi(Va)<phi(a). The AM-GM argument is a hand proof; the symbolic output only checks the algebraic identities and is not itself a proof.
